```{r setup, include=FALSE, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
# Load the necessary packages
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)

library(caret)
```


```{r read_data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
churn <- read_csv(here('data/raw', 'Churn_Modelling.csv'))
head(churn)
```
## Data Partition for training and prediction.
```{r}
set.seed(123)

churn <- churn %>%
  mutate(Exited = factor(Exited))   # 0 = stayed, 1 = churned

train_index <- createDataPartition(churn$Exited, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)

train <- churn[train_index, ]
test  <- churn[-train_index, ]
```

## RG model with class weight to counter the imbalance 
```{r}
library(ranger)
class_weights <- c("0" = 1, "1" = 4)   # churners 4x weight
set.seed(123)

rf_w_model <- ranger(
  Exited ~ Geography + Gender + Age + Tenure +
    NumOfProducts + IsActiveMember + CreditScore + Balance,
  data       = train,
  num.trees      = 300,    # number of trees
  mtry       = 3,      # no. of variables tried at each split (sqrt of 8 ≈ 3)
  probability    = TRUE,
  class.weights  = class_weights
)

print(rf_w_model)
```

```{r}
rf_w_probs <- predict(rf_w_model, data = test)$predictions[, "1"]

rf_w_pred_03 <- ifelse(rf_w_probs >= 0.3, "1", "0")
rf_w_pred_03 <- factor(rf_w_pred_03, levels = c("0", "1"))

rf_w_cm_03 <- confusionMatrix(rf_w_pred_03, test$Exited, positive = "1")
rf_w_cm_03
rf_w_cm_03$byClass[c("Recall", "Precision")]
```
```{r}
library(fastshap)

# Define prediction wrapper for ranger probability model
pred_wrapper <- function(model, newdata) {
  predict(model, data = newdata)$predictions[, "1"]
}

# Explanation set
X_explain <- test %>%
  select(Geography, Gender, Age, Tenure,
         NumOfProducts, IsActiveMember, CreditScore, Balance)

# Compute SHAP values
shap_values <- explain(
  rf_w_model,
  X = X_explain,
  pred_wrapper = pred_wrapper,
  nsim = 50
)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Convert to data frame
shap_df <- as.data.frame(shap_values)

# Global importance — mean absolute SHAP per feature
shap_importance <- shap_df %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ mean(abs(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Feature", values_to = "MeanAbsSHAP") %>%
  arrange(desc(MeanAbsSHAP))

# Sav# Create plots folder if it doesn't exist
dir.create("/Users/stevemathew/stevemac-portfolio/projects/uk-energy-churn/plots", 
           recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Save plot
png("/Users/stevemathew/stevemac-portfolio/projects/uk-energy-churn/plots/shap_importance.png", 
    width = 1200, height = 800)

ggplot(shap_importance, aes(x = reorder(Feature, MeanAbsSHAP), y = MeanAbsSHAP)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Global SHAP Feature Importance",
    x = "Feature",
    y = "Mean |SHAP value|"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

dev.off()
```

```{r}
shap_long <- shap_df %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_longer(-row_id, names_to = "Feature", values_to = "SHAP")

feature_long <- X_explain %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%  # convert before row_id
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%               # add row_id after
  pivot_longer(-row_id, names_to = "Feature", values_to = "Value")

shap_long <- shap_long %>%
  left_join(feature_long, by = c("row_id", "Feature")) %>%
  mutate(Value = as.numeric(Value))

png("/Users/stevemathew/stevemac-portfolio/projects/uk-energy-churn/plots/shap_beeswarm.png",
    width = 1200, height = 800)

ggplot(shap_long, aes(x = SHAP, y = reorder(Feature, abs(SHAP)), color = Value)) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.2, alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red", na.value = "grey50") +
  labs(
    title = "SHAP Value Distribution by Feature",
    x = "SHAP Value",
    y = "Feature",
    color = "Feature Value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

dev.off()
```
```{r}
# Pick one churner and one stayer for explanation
churner_idx <- which(test$Exited == "1")[1]
stayer_idx <- which(test$Exited == "0")[1]

# Churner waterfall
churner_shap <- shap_df[churner_idx, ] %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Feature", values_to = "SHAP") %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(SHAP)))

png("/Users/stevemathew/stevemac-portfolio/projects/uk-energy-churn/plots/shap_waterfall_churner.png",
    width = 1000, height = 700)

ggplot(churner_shap, aes(x = reorder(Feature, SHAP), y = SHAP, 
                          fill = SHAP > 0)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#e74c3c", "FALSE" = "#3498db"),
                    labels = c("TRUE" = "Increases churn risk", 
                               "FALSE" = "Decreases churn risk")) +
  labs(
    title = "SHAP Explanation — Example Churner",
    x = "Feature", y = "SHAP Value", fill = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

dev.off()
```
